title: Rightmove reveals most-viewed properties in first half of 2026
summary:
Rightmove has released data on the most-viewed residential properties listed on its platform during the first six months of 2026, revealing a diverse range of homes spanning from £250,000 to £20 million. The properties attracting the highest number of clicks varied significantly in price point and location, though all featured distinctive characteristics that differentiated them from standard listings.

title: UK property transactions stabilise in June after declines
summary:
UK residential property transactions halted a two-month decline in June 2026, reaching 98,700 on a seasonally adjusted basis. The marginal increase of less than 1% from May's 98,460 transactions came despite traditionally stronger spring market conditions, with industry experts citing mortgage rate uncertainty and tax policy concerns as dampening factors.

title: UK housing shortage blamed on planning rules, not land scarcity
summary:
Britain's housing shortage and weak economic growth stem from decades of restrictive planning policy rather than a lack of available land, according to a new report from the Institute of Economic Affairs. The briefing argues that annual housebuilding growth has fallen from 1-2% historically to around 0.5% currently.

title: Estate agents trial AI photo enhancement for listings
summary:
Major estate agency group Spicerhaart has been testing artificial intelligence technology to enhance property photographs, marking what industry observers suggest could become standard practice across the sector. The trials involve digitally removing clutter, furnishing empty rooms, and demonstrating decorative schemes, though regulatory guidance requires clear labelling of enhanced images.

title: 1.5 million UK properties deemed unmortgageable by lenders
summary:
Approximately 1.5 million UK properties are considered too risky for standard mortgages by mainstream lenders, representing 6% of the total housing stock. Properties including thatched cottages, high-rise apartments, and homes lacking functional facilities fail to meet traditional lending criteria.

title: New HMRC powers to penalise landlord tax reporting errors
summary:
Landlords face new penalties for uncorrected tax reporting errors under legislation set to take effect in April 2027, according to provisions in the Finance Bill 2027. HMRC recovered £104.3 million in unpaid tax from 11,511 property owners in 2025 to 2026.

title: UK house price growth slows to 1.8% in July
summary:
UK house price growth decelerated to 1.8% annually in July, down from 2.2% in June, with the average property price at £277,542. The slowdown reflects elevated mortgage rates, economic uncertainty and concerns over potential tax changes affecting buyer confidence.

title: Connells Group reports £500,000 loss in first half of 2026
summary:
Connells Group recorded a loss of £500,000 during the first six months of 2026, a significant reversal from the £28.4 million profit reported in the same period last year. The estate agency group, owned by Skipton Building Society, attributed the loss to subdued market conditions and ongoing restructuring costs.

title: Rightmove faces £2.3m legal costs over competition claim
summary:
Rightmove has disclosed that it expects to incur £2.3 million in legal costs this year relating to a class action lawsuit alleging anti-competitive behaviour. The property portal's operating costs increased by 17% to £77.7 million as it prepares to defend the £1.5 billion claim at a November tribunal hearing.

title: Rightmove reports 7% revenue growth with AI expansion
summary:
Property portal Rightmove has reported a 7% year-on-year revenue increase to £225.8 million for the first half of 2026. The company has deployed 46 strategic AI initiatives, with its AI-enabled valuation tool contributing to a 50% increase in unique leads to estate agents.
